complexity.notes: Identical logic to the previous submission plus a recursion-limit bump so deep trees don't crash. The sentinel test `greatest == float('-inf')` to detect the top-level call is a bit hacky — setting the limit once at module level or wrapping the recursion in a helper would be cleaner. ||An iterative traversal with an explicit stack|| would sidestep the recursion limit entirely, though it has the same O(n) time and O(h) space.
complexity.summary: Recursive DFS carrying the maximum value seen so far; a node is counted as good when its value meets or exceeds that running max, and the sum over both subtrees is returned.
